welcome.lead: Ask about the state of the water system, or how one of its signals has moved.
welcome.caveat: The answers come from ICONICS, not from the model’s memory. Not every signal has history; if you ask about the past of one that doesn’t, it will say so rather than invent it. The limits each value is judged against are our own estimates, not confirmed ranges from the plant.

notes.cancelledPartial: You cancelled the query; the answer was left half-written.
notes.blocked: Answer blocked: the model did not consult the plant data.
notes.copyFailed: The browser would not allow copying.
